name: delano
description: Plan, execute, and review agent-assisted work with file-backed delivery contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Carry delivery context between agents and sessions.
interface.longDescription: Ten workflows for discovery, research, prototyping, planning, task breakdown, execution, quality, synchronization, closeout, and learning. Keep decisions, tasks, and verification records in your repository. Includes contract templates and works without a repository-installed Delano runtime.
defaultPrompt: Use Delano to turn this feature request into a delivery plan.
Use Delano to continue the next ready task in this repository.
Use Delano to review the evidence before closing this project.
